data.cultural_impact: Gautami is a name that holds immense significance in Hindu culture, particularly in India. The name is associated with the great sage Valmiki, who is believed to have given the name 'Sita' to Goddess Sita, the consort of Lord Rama. Valmiki is said to have adopted Sita as his daughter and named her Gautami Putra (or Gautama Putri), meaning 'daughter of sage Gautama'. This name carries the blessings and wisdom of the sage, and is often given to children as a mark of respect and honor.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Gautami holds great spiritual significance. It is believed that the name bears the power and blessings of the sage Gotama. Gotama was a revered sage in Hinduism, known for his deep wisdom and enlightenment. By adopting the name Gautami, one is believed to be connected to the spiritual lineage of Gotama, and is bestowed with the blessings of wisdom and knowledge. This name is also believed to bring peace, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gautami derives from the sage Gautama, symbolizing wisdom and inner strength. The name carries the grace of ancient knowledge and the determination to seek enlightenment.

vedic_reference.note: From the Vedic Sanskrit roots 'गौ' (cow) and 'तमि' (to cross or flow), symbolizing a river that nourishes and sustains life.

historical_references.reference: Gautami Putra Satakarni was a Satavahana king ruling in the Deccan plateau from 76 to 130 AD. The Satavahanas were a major power in ancient India and at their height ruled over most of peninsular India.

Gautami Balasri, also known as Matsyendranath or Shankaracharya, was an 11th century saint and philosopher who is one of the founders of the Nath sampradaya (tradition) in Hinduism. He is considered a precursor to the tantric movement in Hinduism.

modern_usage.modern_context: Gautami, a name of Hindu origin, is gaining popularity in modern contexts due to its association with spiritualism, acting, and literature. In the realm of spiritualism, Gautami is the name of various Hindu spiritual leaders and teachers. On Instagram, there are several accounts dedicated to Gautami, sharing her teachings, quotes, and inspirational stories. In the world of acting, there is a renowned Tamil actress named Revathy Asha Rao, popularly known as Revathy or Gautami, who has made significant contributions to the film industry. Lastly, in literature, there is a work of fiction titled 'Gautami' by the Malayalam author S.I. Madhusoodaran, which explores the spiritual journey of its protagonist.

name_in_real_life.story: Radha Gautami, a teacher in Delhi, India, shares that their name Gautami meaning "Descendant of sage Gotama" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
